_about: Spore teardown (mhvnsnt/teardown-spore, T1) — the part-grammar layer under the species data system. The grammar is Spore's documented construction at systems level: a sculptable spine plus SEVEN functional part categories, parts carrying cost + complexity against authoring budgets. Mochiichao species stay canon-locked designs (Jamar's cast does not become freeform) — the grammar is how species are DESCRIBED, VARIED and EVOLVED in data: stages of a species are part deltas on one spine profile. Category ids are functional vocabulary, not Maxis part names; the catalogue ships EMPTY because Mochiichao part rows (own names, own art) are canon content, authored per species, never invented by the wiring.

budget._note: null = unset; budget VALUES are balancing/canon slots set when the first catalogue rows are authored, not invented here.

catalogueEntryShape.category: one of the seven category ids
catalogueEntryShape.dietClass: string, optional — the diet class this part confers (mouth category)
catalogueEntryShape.grants: string[] — capability ids in Mochiichao's own ability vocabulary
catalogueEntryShape.movementClass: string, optional — the movement class this part confers

categories.role: locomotion beyond feet (wings, fins, jets as canon allows)
